This off-axle hitch needs gradual corrections and room to recover; pulling forward while turning can create another contact.

An early left arc cleared the first bend after later attempts hit the trailer’s rear-right corner. Start the right arc early and hold it longer through the second bend; straightening too soon caused rear-left contacts. Ease the turn and straighten gradually for the bay. Pulling forward too far caused tractor front-corner contacts, so watch both ends and leave room for recovery. This off-axle hitch needs early, gradual corrections.

An early gradual leftward trailer turn cleared the first bend after a straight approach hit the rear-right rail. Begin the rightward correction early and hold it through the second bend; a weaker correction still hit the rear-left rail. Near the bay, another rightward adjustment cleared the final rear-left contact. Pull forward to make room after a touch, and steer gently: the tractor's front can swing into the rail during recovery.

The first rightward arc hit the cart’s rear-right corner; a gentle leftward arc cleared that bend. Later the rear-left corner repeatedly hit the rail even after short pull-forwards and sharper right turns. Reposition earlier toward the opening instead of retrying from nearly the same line, and watch both rear corners. This short cart reacts quickly: use small corrections and follow the turn early.

The cart's rear-left corner repeatedly struck the bend when the rightward turn began too late or was eased too soon. Pulling farther forward and starting a stronger rightward arc earlier cleared the bend; then follow the cart gradually. Watch both cart corners and the mower's right side. Near the bay, a straightened approach succeeded after the curved approach touched a rail. This short cart reacts quickly, so use small corrections at low speed.

The cart hit the rear-right rail at the first bend; an earlier leftward shift cleared it. At the later bend, repeated rear-left contacts came from turning right too late. Pulling farther forward, starting the rightward arc early, then straightening before the rail cleared the approach to the bay. Watch both rear corners and the mower's front; this short cart reacts quickly, so make small corrections and follow the cart early.

An early gradual turn reached the middle of the bend, but repeated rear-left trailer contacts and left-side cab contacts ended the run. Easing the hitch did not immediately move the long trailer's rear away from the rail, and pulling forward with left steering drove the cab into it. Watch the camera and left mirror before clearance disappears, begin the turn and exit alignment early, and check cab clearance before any forward recovery.

A gradual early turn made steady progress through the bend, but repeated resets and excessive articulation caused left-side contacts at the trailer and cab. Watch the left mirror as well as the rear camera, and protect the cab when pulling forward. Begin straightening well before the bay entrance; the long trailer responds slowly, so make small corrections early and allow time for them to take effect.

Repeated rear-left contacts ended the leg; late steering changes could not move the long trailer rear away from the bend in time. Start the bend setup much earlier, use the camera to track the approaching rear corner, and watch cab clearance during any forward reset. Allow the semi-trailer plenty of distance to respond, and avoid repeating the same approach after contact.
